scene: Inside the rumbling tow truck cab, a glowing neon dachshund buzzes softly.
beats: The neon dachshund lets out a crackling bark and sputters bright blue, just as the truck brakes smoothly inside the hospital bay and the passenger door pops open.
A fuzzy synth melody fills the cab, synchronising with the dashboard glow as the truck rolls through the workshop gates and its doors hiss open wide.
The driver chuckles and slips you a phosphor voucher just as the truck glides beside glowing glass-blowing benches, swinging its doors open to the hum of neon.
picture: A side view inside the truck cab. Far left, a pink neon dachshund glows on the vinyl bench. Left of centre, the player sits wearing his corduroy jacket and beanie. Centre, the dashboard has a chunky CB radio. Right, a scaly green driver steers. Rooftops recede outside the wide window.
shown: a buzzy pink neon dachshund resting on the bench on the far left
a bulky retro CB radio mounted on the dashboard at the centre
a friendly reptilian driver gripping the wide steering wheel on the right

after.beat: You wave the hospital goodbye as the tow truck rumbles past. At the depot, you hop aboard the clanking bridge crawler, which creaks up to gear-lined stalls and simmering soup carts atop Gear Bridge.
